To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the public private partnership is a complex system of relations between public and private entities, based on a contract, which is aimed at the achievement of common goals.

the implementation of public private partnership is a complex process, requiring the development of appropriate legal framework, the creation of a special institution to manage the partnership, the improvement of the staffing capacity of public private partnership and the creation of a favorable business environment.

public-private partnership is a new form of interaction between the state and the business, which is aimed at improving the quality of public services and the development of the economy of the country.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the public private partnership as a tool for improving the quality and quantity of the public sector services.
the public private partnership practice in the developed European states.
the public private partnership experience in developed countries and its application to the situation in Ukraine.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the experience of developed countries in the implementation of public private partnership is a valuable resource that can be used to improve the efficiency of the implementation of the PPP in Ukraine, and the creation of a special institution for coordination of the PPP implementation in Ukraine is a necessary condition for the development of the partnership between government and business in Ukraine.

the implementation of the public - private partnership in Ukraine requires the development of a comprehensive and detailed legal regulation, the creation of a special institution to manage the public private partnership, as well as the development of the appropriate methodology documentation for the implementation of the PPP in the sphere of the construction of the infrastructure objects.

the public private partnership is a new and promising tool for solving the problems of public administration and management, and the implementation of this tool requires the establishment of a special institution to manage the process of the partnership between government and business, the creation of appropriate legal and regulatory frameworks, and the development of a special methodology of the partnership between state and business.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the implementation of public private partnership in developed countries has been accompanied by a gradual transition from a short term to a long term partnership, which was possible due to the establishment of special institutions and agencies to coordinate the process of public private partnership, the development of appropriate methodology documentation and the introduction of a new approach to public procurement.
the public private partnership is a new form of interaction of government and business in the construction and operation assets of strategic importance for the development of society.
the experience of foreign countries can be used to develop the public private partnership system in Ukraine.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the public private partnership is an important tool for the development of the Ukrainian economy and it is necessary to implement the public private partnership on a large scale.

the public private partnership is a promising and effective form of cooperation between the public and private sectors, which allows to attract the resources and competences of the private sector for the implementation of public projects, and the state guarantees and provides the necessary resources for the implementation of projects of the private sector, and also contributes to the development of the economy, improving the quality of public services and increasing the transparency of public administration.
it is necessary to develop the national model of public private partnership in order to create a favorable environment for the implementation of the PPP in Ukraine.
